## WBS-ORK — Orchestration Agent

**트리거**: Webhook(wbs-ork) + Schedule(매주 금 17:00) + Manual

**플로우**:
1. Init Params → 주간 날짜 계산
2. Call WBS-GRC → Repo 분류 + Commit 집계
3. [병렬 6개] WBS-JRA / WBS-DDA / WBS-BAK / WBS-FRT / WBS-CFG / WBS-MOB
4. Merge → Integrate (부분 실패 처리)
5. Build Call Flow Map → Merge Design Gaps
6. Ollama Gap Analysis (있을 때만)
7. Calc Design Score → Calc Progress Score
8. Respond (Webhook) / Log (Manual/Schedule)

**진척률 가중치**:
- Jira 티켓 완료율 × 40%
- SP 소진률 × 40%
- Commit 활성일 × 20%
